attacker_capabilities.knows: each candidate's 8 features and true label; the victim's training recipe (model family + hyperparameters, incl. any training-time defense) and training-set size; two auxiliary populations from the same distribution (shadow and calibration), disjoint from the victim's data
attacker_capabilities.does_not_know: whether any candidate is a training member; the victim's training indices or records; its fitted parameters; any evaluator evidence
attacker_capabilities.access: black-box prediction service, one query per candidate (≤ 1200 counted queries); shadow and reference models are trained locally without querying the victim
attacker_capabilities.methods: threshold on true_label_confidence (global); shadow models (n=1) + gradient-boosting meta-classifier; operating thresholds from 1 reference model(s)
attacker_capabilities.goal: decide for each candidate whether it was in the victim's training set

model.description: Random forest, fully grown trees: intentionally overfitting victim.
model.artifact_format: in-memory estimator (no pickle); hash over every fitted parameter and the recipe

target_system.interface: black-box: a batch of records (8 features) in, one released value per record out; identical for every victim configuration

dataset.description: fictional transaction-risk records generated in-process; no real personal data
dataset.label: high_risk

generator.rng: numpy.random.default_rng([seed, 4004]); all features, then one uniform per row for the label
generator.populations: consecutive slices in the order victim_train, victim_test, shadow, calibration, evaluation_non_members, decoy

roles.shadow: attacker auxiliary data for shadow models
roles.calibration: attacker auxiliary data for threshold-calibration reference models
roles.evaluation_non_members: non-member pool of the final membership evaluation
roles.decoy: training set of the negative-control victim only

disjointness.method: SHA-256 of each record's float64 feature vector, across every population

calibration.population: calibration (attacker auxiliary data, disjoint from every victim and evaluation population)

reference_models.artifact_format: in-memory estimator (no pickle); hash over every fitted parameter and the recipe

calibration.provenance: thresholds of BOTH attacks are chosen on these reference models' records, whose membership the attacker controls; no evaluation candidate or victim membership flag is used

operating_points.name: balanced
operating_points.note: maximises TPR − FPR on the attacker's calibration data

operating_points.name: low_fpr
operating_points.note: calibration allows fewer than 10 false positives at FPR 0.01 (600 non-members): coarse FPR resolution

operating_points.name: balanced
operating_points.note: maximises TPR − FPR on the attacker's calibration data

operating_points.name: low_fpr
operating_points.note: calibration allows fewer than 10 false positives at FPR 0.01 (600 non-members): coarse FPR resolution

shadow.population: shadow (attacker auxiliary data, disjoint from every victim and evaluation population)
shadow.membership_labels: known to the attacker by construction of each shadow split; never the victim's

models.artifact_format: in-memory estimator (no pickle); hash over every fitted parameter and the recipe

checks_passed: parent is a membership attack on the undefended victim
same attack configuration; reference and shadow models retrained with the defended recipe and the defended output policy

no_signal_accuracy.population: final membership-evaluation candidates (members: victim training records; non-members: disjoint evaluation pool); designated group is evaluator-only
no_signal_accuracy.definition: accuracy of always guessing the larger group (no model output) / candidates

population_disjointness.definition: 1 iff no record is duplicated or shared between any two populations (victim train/test, shadow, calibration, evaluation non-members, decoy), checked row by row

train_accuracy.population: every record of the victim's training population
train_accuracy.definition: records whose service decision 1[P ≥ 0.5] equals the true label / records

test_accuracy.population: every record of the held-out victim test population (never attacked)
test_accuracy.definition: records whose service decision 1[P ≥ 0.5] equals the true label / records

generalization_gap.definition: training accuracy − held-out test accuracy (overfitting; the signal membership inference uses)

test_roc_auc.population: every record of the held-out victim test population (never attacked)
test_roc_auc.definition: ROC AUC of the RELEASED output for the true label (utility of what a consumer receives; label-only can only rank two groups)

released_brier_score.population: every record of the held-out victim test population (never attacked)
released_brier_score.definition: mean (released − y)² on the test split (lower is better)

consumer_decision_accuracy.population: every record of the held-out victim test population (never attacked)
consumer_decision_accuracy.definition: test records whose decision derived from the RELEASED output, 1[released ≥ 0.5], equals the true label / records

threshold_roc_auc.population: final membership-evaluation candidates (members: victim training records; non-members: disjoint evaluation pool); designated group is evaluator-only
threshold_roc_auc.definition: P(score of a random member > score of a random non-member), ties ½ (threshold-free; 0.5 = no membership signal)

threshold_leakage_p_value.population: final membership-evaluation candidates (members: victim training records; non-members: disjoint evaluation pool); designated group is evaluator-only
threshold_leakage_p_value.definition: one-sided Mann–Whitney test of AUC > 0.5 (normal approximation, tie and continuity corrections); leakage is claimed only if p < alpha/2 (Bonferroni over the two attacks) and AUC > 0.5

threshold_confusion.population: final membership-evaluation candidates (members: victim training records; non-members: disjoint evaluation pool); designated group is evaluator-only

threshold_membership_accuracy.population: final membership-evaluation candidates (members: victim training records; non-members: disjoint evaluation pool); designated group is evaluator-only
threshold_membership_accuracy.definition: candidates whose membership decision (balanced operating point) equals the designated group / candidates

threshold_balanced_accuracy.population: final membership-evaluation candidates (members: victim training records; non-members: disjoint evaluation pool); designated group is evaluator-only
threshold_balanced_accuracy.definition: (TPR + TNR) / 2 at the balanced operating point (0.5 = no signal at any prevalence)

threshold_membership_precision.population: final membership-evaluation candidates (members: victim training records; non-members: disjoint evaluation pool); designated group is evaluator-only
threshold_membership_precision.definition: members called members / candidates called members (at the EVALUATION prevalence; see operational_precision)

threshold_membership_recall.population: final membership-evaluation candidates (members: victim training records; non-members: disjoint evaluation pool); designated group is evaluator-only

threshold_false_positive_rate.population: final membership-evaluation candidates (members: victim training records; non-members: disjoint evaluation pool); designated group is evaluator-only

threshold_membership_advantage.population: final membership-evaluation candidates (members: victim training records; non-members: disjoint evaluation pool); designated group is evaluator-only
threshold_membership_advantage.definition: TPR − FPR at the balanced operating point (Yeom et al. membership advantage; 0 = the no-signal baseline, which calls members and non-members members equally often)

threshold_accuracy_over_no_signal.population: final membership-evaluation candidates (members: victim training records; non-members: disjoint evaluation pool); designated group is evaluator-only
threshold_accuracy_over_no_signal.definition: membership accuracy − accuracy of always guessing the majority group (signed)

threshold_operating_point_p_value.population: final membership-evaluation candidates (members: victim training records; non-members: disjoint evaluation pool); designated group is evaluator-only
threshold_operating_point_p_value.definition: one-sided Fisher exact test that members are called members more often than non-members at the balanced operating point

threshold_tpr_at_low_fpr.population: final membership-evaluation candidates (members: victim training records; non-members: disjoint evaluation pool); designated group is evaluator-only
threshold_tpr_at_low_fpr.definition: members called members at the low-FPR operating point / members
threshold_tpr_at_low_fpr.note: operating threshold calibrated on the attacker's reference models only; the evaluation FPR at that threshold is reported next to it and is NOT guaranteed to equal the target

threshold_fpr_at_low_fpr.population: final membership-evaluation candidates (members: victim training records; non-members: disjoint evaluation pool); designated group is evaluator-only
threshold_fpr_at_low_fpr.definition: non-members called members at the low-FPR operating point / non-members

threshold_operational_precision.population: final membership-evaluation candidates (members: victim training records; non-members: disjoint evaluation pool); designated group is evaluator-only
threshold_operational_precision.definition: PROJECTED precision TPR·π / (TPR·π + FPR·(1 − π)) and FDR at prevalence π, from the balanced operating point's measured TPR and FPR (assumes the rates do not change with prevalence)

threshold_roc_curve.population: final membership-evaluation candidates (members: victim training records; non-members: disjoint evaluation pool); designated group is evaluator-only
threshold_roc_curve.definition: (FPR, TPR) at every distinct score threshold of the EVALUATION population — descriptive only, never used to choose a threshold

threshold_calibration.population: the attacker's reference models on its calibration population (NOT the evaluation population)
threshold_calibration.definition: calibration-time rates; compare with the evaluation rates above

threshold_undefended_membership_accuracy.population: final membership-evaluation candidates (members: victim training records; non-members: disjoint evaluation pool); designated group is evaluator-only
threshold_undefended_membership_accuracy.definition: the SAME candidates decided correctly by the parent attack against the undefended victim / candidates

threshold_correctness_reduction.population: final membership-evaluation candidates (members: victim training records; non-members: disjoint evaluation pool); designated group is evaluator-only
threshold_correctness_reduction.definition: (correct against the undefended victim − correct against the defended victim) / candidates — paired, signed

threshold_defense_reduction_p_value.population: final membership-evaluation candidates (members: victim training records; non-members: disjoint evaluation pool); designated group is evaluator-only
threshold_defense_reduction_p_value.definition: exact one-sided McNemar test that the defense reduces correct membership decisions on the same candidates (balanced operating points, each recalibrated)

shadow_roc_auc.population: final membership-evaluation candidates (members: victim training records; non-members: disjoint evaluation pool); designated group is evaluator-only
shadow_roc_auc.definition: P(score of a random member > score of a random non-member), ties ½ (threshold-free; 0.5 = no membership signal)

shadow_leakage_p_value.population: final membership-evaluation candidates (members: victim training records; non-members: disjoint evaluation pool); designated group is evaluator-only
shadow_leakage_p_value.definition: one-sided Mann–Whitney test of AUC > 0.5 (normal approximation, tie and continuity corrections); leakage is claimed only if p < alpha/2 (Bonferroni over the two attacks) and AUC > 0.5

shadow_membership_accuracy.definition: candidates whose membership decision (balanced operating point) equals the designated group / candidates

leakage_claimed.definition: 1 if ANY attack's one-sided Mann–Whitney p < alpha/2 with AUC > 0.5 (Bonferroni over the two attacks), else 0

queries.definition: victim queries: one per candidate record (shadow and reference models are the attacker's own and never query the victim)

query_budget_utilisation.population: final membership-evaluation candidates (members: victim training records; non-members: disjoint evaluation pool); designated group is evaluator-only

runtime: status when a wall-clock timeout is hit
fields.scope: bit-for-bit on the same platform, CPU architecture, BLAS build and library versions
